lessons.title: Vision-language models
lessons.description: Connect vision, documents, audio and retrieval.
lessons.conceptOverview: CLIP-style learning aligns image and text representations using paired examples. A vision encoder produces features; a projection layer can map them into the language-model embedding space as visual tokens. Image resolution and tiling affect token count, latency and small-text recognition.

sections.content: Compare retrieval for a whole-page image and cropped regions. Record where chart labels or small text disappear and explain the resolution tradeoff.

lessons.title: Document, audio & video pipelines
lessons.description: Connect vision, documents, audio and retrieval.
lessons.conceptOverview: Document AI combines OCR, layout detection and table or form structure. Preserve page and bounding-box provenance. Speech recognition transcribes audio, diarization separates speakers, and TTS synthesizes speech. Video pipelines sample frames and retain timestamps; sparse sampling can miss short events.

lessons.title: Multimodal RAG
lessons.description: Connect vision, documents, audio and retrieval.
lessons.conceptOverview: Index text, image and document representations with source metadata. Retrieve compatible representations, rerank candidates and provide the original evidence to the answer generator. Cross-modal similarity requires an aligned embedding space. Evaluate retrieval separately from extraction and answer faithfulness.
